assets.name: office-background
assets.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: seamless full-screen environment background for a first-person realistic Chinese office H5 game; not a screenshot, no UI.
Primary request: wide landscape 16:9 photorealistic 3D game environment at a seated employee's eye level in a lived-in, modest contemporary Shanghai open plan office during warm late afternoon.
Composition/framing: left-side windows and blinds cast soft sunlight; low green-partition desks in the middle distance; a glass meeting room and a clear open right-side aisle are clearly visible in the upper right. The bottom 38 percent of the frame is a clean warm pale oak desk surface extending across the full foreground. Keep the broad center and right of this foreground desk entirely EMPTY, unobstructed negative space so a separately rendered monitor and hands can later be layered on it. No foreground monitor, screen, computer, laptop, keyboard, mouse or phone. Include only a small potted plant far left, a ceramic coffee cup at the far-left desk edge, and understated stationery on the left.
Style/medium: high-quality realistic game environment rendering with photographic architectural depth and ordinary office scale, nuanced natural materials, clean readable spatial structure. Detailed crisp foreground, moderate natural distant depth, no extreme blur.
Lighting/mood: warm late afternoon daylight, calm ordinary workday, cinematic but modest not luxury.
Color palette: muted warm beige and olive green.
Constraints: no people, hands, arms or human silhouettes in foreground; no readable text, logos, watermarks, UI. Full-bleed landscape image, no borders.

assets.name: manager
assets.prompt:
Use case: photorealistic-natural
Asset type: photorealistic transparent PNG character cutout for a first-person realistic Chinese office H5 game.
Primary request: isolated adult Chinese male office manager in his late 30s, framed from the top of his uncropped head to his upper thighs. Pale blue near-white rolled-sleeve button-up shirt, dark trousers, plain ID lanyard with no readable letters. Holding a thin beige folder with his left arm; his right hand rests relaxed at his side. All hands fully visible with correct natural anatomy.
Composition/framing: centered person with ample transparent margin all around. Three-quarter body angled toward camera-left, looking toward the viewer with a mild, calm, inquisitive facial expression, approachable and not threatening. Camera at a seated employee's eye level, looking slightly up at him. Waist and upper thighs at the bottom will be occluded by a separately rendered foreground desk.
Lighting/style: photorealistic high-quality realistic 3D game character matching a modest contemporary Shanghai office; soft warm daylight from image left, muted warm colors, nuanced skin and natural cloth folds.
Background requirement: actual fully transparent background with real alpha channel, suitable for direct compositing. Do not paint a checkerboard or solid background. No desk, office, ground, floor, scene, shadow plane or other props beyond the folder and lanyard.
Constraints: uncropped head, hair and both hands; no text, logos, borders, watermark or UI; no additional people.
